headline: Congress holds pro forma sessions Friday as summer winds down, both chambers return Tuesday.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate convened in pro forma session at 10:00 a.m. on Friday, September 4th and immediately adjourned. The brief gathering maintained the Senate's presence without conducting substantive business.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met briefly at 10 a.m. on Friday, September 4th in a shortened session, adjourning at 10:02 a.m. Six new bills (H.R. 10298-10303) and two resolutions (H. Res. 1512-1513) were introduced, with no votes taken.
